changeWatch.title: Revised ESRS delegated act (adopted 3 Jul 2026) — scrutiny pending
changeWatch.expected: Entry into force expected 20 Nov 2026 subject to Parliament/Council scrutiny and OJ publication; applies to FY beginning on/after 1 Jan 2027, FY2026 early adoption once in force
changeWatch.note: On entry into force: set packFlags.revised_esrs_in_force=true, bump pack version, re-run golden profiles, then re-evaluate customer determinations. Until then this act must not change any current determination.

changeWatch.title: Voluntary sustainability standard delegated act — value-chain cap catalogue
changeWatch.expected: Same scrutiny track as the revised ESRS; the cap item catalogue for S-011 mappings versions against this act
changeWatch.note: Caution: the cap protection does not extend to GHG emissions metrics — an above-cap analysis must not tell a supplier it can decline emissions data requests.

changeWatch.title: Omnibus I national transpositions (deadline 19 Mar 2027)
changeWatch.expected: Member-State implementing measures and FY2025–26 transitional options land country by country
changeWatch.note: Each published national measure feeds a country pack; a country enters the ratified_country_packs catalogue only after expert ratification.

changeWatch.title: EFRAG standard for non-EU groups (Art. 40a N-ESRS)
changeWatch.expected: Standard-setting active; Art. 40a reporting starts for FY beginning on/after 1 Jan 2028
changeWatch.note: Third-country obligations O-012/O-013 reference the applicable standard; keep versioned.
